questions.question:
Consider the following two statements.

S1: If a candidate is known to be corrupt, then he will not be elected
S2: If a candidate is kind, he will be elected

Which one of the following statements follows from S1 and S2 as per sound inference rules of logic?

options.A: If a person is known to be corrupt, he is kind
options.B: If a person is not known to be corrupt, he is not kind
options.C: If a person is kind, he is not known to be corrupt
options.D: If a person is not kind, he is not known to be corrupt

questions.explanation:
Checking each statement:
- S1: corrupt [latex]\rightarrow\neg[/latex] elected, whose contrapositive is elected [latex]\rightarrow\neg[/latex] corrupt
- S2: kind [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] elected

Chaining: kind [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] elected [latex]\rightarrow\neg[/latex] corrupt.

Answer: If a person is kind, he is not known to be corrupt

questions.question:
A Young tableau is a 2D array of integers increasing from left to right and from top to bottom. Any unfilled entries are marked with [latex]\infty[/latex], and hence there cannot be any entry to the right of, or below a [latex]\infty[/latex]. The following Young tableau consists of unique entries.

When an element is removed from a Young tableau, other elements should be moved into its place so that the resulting table is still a Young tableau (unfilled entries may be filled in with a [latex]\infty[/latex]). The minimum number of entries (other than 1) to be shifted, to remove 1 from the given Young tableau is _______.
questions.explanation:
Removing 1 leaves a hole. Repeatedly fill it with the smaller of its right and lower neighbour:

- hole (1,1): min(2, 3) = 2 moves left
- hole (1,2): min(5, 4) = 4 moves up
- hole (2,2): min(6, 12) = 6 moves left
- hole (2,3): min(23, 18) = 18 moves up
- hole (3,3): min(25, [latex]\infty[/latex]) = 25 moves left
- hole (3,4) gets [latex]\infty[/latex]

Shifted: 2, 4, 6, 18, 25 = 5 entries

Answer: 5

This sequence of instructions is to be executed in a pipelined instruction processor with the following 4 stages: (1) Instruction Fetch and Decode (IF), (2) Operand Fetch (OF), (3) Perform Operation (PO) and (4) Write back the result (WB). The IF, OF and WB stages take 1 clock cycle each for any instruction. The PO stage takes 1 clock cycle for ADD or SUB instruction, 3 clock cycles for MUL instruction and 5 clock cycles for DIV instruction. The pipelined processor uses operand forwarding from the PO stage to the OF stage.

The number of clock cycles taken for the execution of the above sequence of instructions is ___________.
questions.explanation:
Cycle-by-cycle (PO stage can hold one instruction at a time; results forwarded from PO):

- MUL: IF 1, OF 2, PO 3-5, WB 6
- DIV: IF 2, OF 3, PO 6-10, WB 11
- ADD: IF 3, OF 4, waits for R6, PO 11, WB 12
- SUB: IF 4, OF 5, waits for R7, PO 12, WB 13

Answer: 13
